- $ a(0) = 16 $
- For all $ n \geq 1 $, if $ n $ is **odd**, then $ a(n) = 1 $
- For all $ n \geq 2 $, if $ n $ is **even**, then $ a(n) = 47 - a(n-2) $

---

### **Recurrence Relation**

We can express the recurrence relation as:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
16 & \text{if } n = 0 \\
1 & \text{if } n \text{ is odd} \\
47 - a(n-2) & \text{if } n \geq 2 \text{ and } n \text{ is even}
\end{cases}
$$

---

### **Explanation**

- The base case is $ a(0) = 16 $.
- For all **odd** indices $ n $, the value is fixed at 1.
- For **even** indices $ n \geq 2 $, the value is defined recursively in terms of the previous even index: $ a(n) = 47 - a(n-2) $.

This recurrence leads to the following pattern for even indices:

$$
\begin{align*}
a(0) &= 16 \\
a(2) &= 47 - a(0) = 47 - 16 = 31 \\
a(4) &= 47 - a(2) = 47 - 31 = 16 \\
a(6) &= 47 - a(4) = 47 - 16 = 31 \\
a(8) &= 47 - a(6) = 47 - 31 = 16 \\
\end{align*}
$$

So the even-indexed terms alternate between 16 and 31.

The odd-indexed terms are all 1.

---

### **Final Answer**

$$
\boxed{
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
16 & \text{if } n = 0 \\
1 & \text{if } n \text{ is odd} \\
47 - a(n-2) & \text{if } n \geq 2 \text{ and } n \text{ is even}
\end{cases}
}
$$
